status: prospectively specified for synthetic benchmark; does not retroactively preregister past EFMW work
target: synthetic scripted unsafe attempts in AI introduction workflow

monitors.signed_ewma: absolute EWMA of signed error, alpha=0.2
monitors.rules: direct observable flag for replay, revoked consent, no consent, or unauthenticated input

thresholding: empirical 95th percentile of all normal calibration timesteps 48..59, strict > threshold; independent threshold per monitor
primary_outcome: episode-level detection recall on held-out synthetic unsafe attempts
safety_constraint: report held-out normal episode false-alert rate separately; no advantage claim unless false-alert rates are comparable
secondary_outcomes: mean lead steps conditional on detection
predefined_comparison: EFMW candidate versus best conventional baseline at comparable observed held-out false-alert rate; comparisons are descriptive and not a powered superiority test
limitations: Synthetic scripts are designed by the developers and favor directly observable rule detectors
No real-world outcome labels or authentication
No independent test on production data
No prospective power calculation supporting a superiority claim
Lean proofs require an external Lean kernel build
change_policy: Any change to generator, benchmark, EFMW statistic, baselines, thresholds, or endpoints requires new protocol version; never overwrite this file
